gen-fs-comico-gf-julius-sans-one: Whimsical and a little bossy, Comico stacks its lowercase like poured lead type. Julius Sans One goes the other way, a plain sans with wide gaps between letters and curves left open at the ends.
gen-fs-comico-gf-lexend-exa: Comico's lowercase is a dense slab, like poured lead type, with its letterspacing stretched wide. Lexend Exa is the sans counterweight: round, wide-open curves and a tall x-height against stubby ascenders and descenders.
gen-fs-comico-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga keeps its linework flat and single-weight. Beside Comico's whimsical, lead-heavy lowercase, its generously tracked words give the page a modern, plain sans counterpoint to the heading's swagger.
gen-fs-comico-gf-lexend-mega: Approachable is the first thing Lexend Mega says, with a drawn-with-one-nib look and a visible gap at the end of every c, under Comico's poured-lead heading. Lines move along easily.
gen-fs-comico-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta is built on curves that never thin out. Its mouth-wide c shapes and big x-height are the pair's strongest quality, set against Comico's whimsical, lead-heavy lowercase and wide letterspacing.
gen-fs-comico-gf-lexend-tera: Comico's lowercase has the weight of poured lead type, spaced wide and bossy. Lexend Tera answers in a plotter-pen line with open-faced curves, so a larger size for Comico and a modest one for the sans would suit them.
gen-fs-comico-gf-lexend-zetta: Comico is whimsical and commanding. It earns its keep big and short, while Lexend Zetta, a plain sans with ribbon-like strokes of constant width and tall-bodied small letters, carries the widely tracked text.
gen-fs-expose-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, with generous space between its curve ends and stems. Expose sits beside it with a compressed, striking cadence and capitals nearly as tall as its lowercase.
gen-fs-expose-gf-abeezee: ABeeZee draws its strokes like neon glass tubing, with terminals finishing well clear of the stem and a high mean line. Against Expose's compressed, striking heading, paragraphs would feel friendly and unhurried.
gen-fs-expose-gf-aldrich: Tight, striking, and refined: that is Expose, built with almost no gap between x-height and caps. Aldrich does its best work differently, tracing a single thick thread of constant ink with cupped, round letters.
